cases.name: a-running-total-inside-one-record
cases.description: The whole idea in one line: a repeat list becomes its own running total. The record is computed whole anyway, so nothing about rows, streaming or parallelism changes.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="cart" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="R"><gen type="number" value="10..99" repeat="3" separator="," accumulate="sum"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{R}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-running-total-of-decimals-is-exact
cases.description: Money. The arithmetic is done on scaled integers, never on floating point, because the five implementations print a float differently — 19.99 + 0.01 has to be 20.00 in all of them.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="money" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="R"><gen type="number" value="199..1999" decimals="2" repeat="3" separator="," accumulate="sum"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{R}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-running-maximum-keeps-the-winning-element
cases.description: max and min return an element that already exists, so its own spelling is kept rather than reformatted. A value drawn as 007 stays 007.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="hi" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="R"><gen type="number" value="10..99" length="3" first_zero="true" repeat="4" separator="," accumulate="max"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{R}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-running-minimum
cases.description: The mirror of max, and the case that says the accumulator moves one way only.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="lo" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="R"><gen type="number" value="10..99" repeat="4" separator="," accumulate="min"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{R}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-running-total-over-a-variable-length-list
cases.description: repeat="1..4" makes the list length a whole-run quota, and the accumulation simply follows whatever length a row got — including a row of one, where the total is the element itself.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="var" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="R"><gen type="number" value="10..99" repeat="1..4" separator="," accumulate="sum"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{R}}</data></line></block></tdc>
